download_common_crawl_shard: download a shard of Common Crawl WET data and export it to JSON format
list_common_crawl_dumps: list all available Common Crawl dump IDs and their WET paths URLs
parse_warc_documents: parse WARC file lines into structured document dicts with URL, title, and raw content
iterate_cc_segments: iterate over Common Crawl WET segments yielding parsed document dicts with caching support
read_cc_shard: read a shard of Common Crawl segments using CCShardReader with configurable shard size
